title: Zoho CRM Vibe Explained: Build Apps by Typing (7 Questions Answered)
description:
Zoho CRM Vibe is a new AI app builder inside Zoho CRM: describe what you need in plain words and it builds a working tab on your live CRM data. In this video, 7 questions: what Vibe is, what you can build (Zoho's own examples: sales leaderboard, account console, commission calculator), the build tools (Suggestions, Surprise Me, Enhance, Discuss mode, Design mode, Snip tool, @ context), the six-area Security Review and Revision History, who gets it (Enterprise, Ultimate, Zoho One Enterprise, Zoho CRM Plus; Manage Extensibility permission; phased rollout starting with US, India and EU data centres), which AI it uses (OpenAI and Anthropic models, ZKS and BYOK) and what users report in the first week.
